items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: I auditioned on tenor sax one time for John Giordano, the sax teacher there, and he says, I went in and auditioned and he says, “Okay get out of here.”

ctx.x: Where did your reading skills come from?

Well I started off learning music at home but I really got to polish my skill at sight reading, polished at North Texas State. Every day in the One O’clock Band. I played lead trombone in the One O’clock Band at North Texas, and lead trumpet in the Three O’clock Band. I auditioned on tenor sax one time for John Giordano, the sax teacher © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

there, and he says, I went in and auditioned and he says, “Okay get out of here.” I said, “What do you mean?” I played the part perfectly. And he says, “I have 60 jazz saxophone majors here this semester. I only have 30 chairs, we only have six bands. He says, “And you’re already playing in two bands and you’re not even a music major so get out of here.” I started off in college at University of Southern Mississippi as a music major.
